manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A Motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and reverses, while the gravity arrow stays the same.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: One ball rises and falls beside a fixed height scale. The blue Motion arrow shortens, disappears at the top and points down on the way back. The dashed gravity arrow always points down with the same length.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.min(Math.max(time,0),T);const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const ah=u*u/(2*g);const ta=u/g;const y0=370,sc=60;const by=y0-h*sc*1;const near=Math.abs(t-ta)<0.004;const v2=near?0:v;const st=near?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const o=[];o.push(...sdk.panel({x:20,y:40,w:600,h:360,title:'Toss',state:st,id:'lane.toss'}));o.push(sdk.line('guide',150,y0+12,330,y0+12,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.t',340,y0+17,'Launch height',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',240,by,24,{}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:290,y:by},{value:v2,direction:'up'},{scale:22,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:200,y:by},{value:-9.8,direction:'up'},{scale:12,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(400,by-30,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return{frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime:ta,apexHeight:ah,velocity:v,height:h}};}
